build.command: cargo clean -p strudeland-host --release && time cargo build --release -p strudeland-host
build.note: dependencies (V8 static library, engine) cached; the host crate rebuilt and LTO-linked from clean

method: strudeland-host bench (release), request { layout linear, fromBar 0, toBar B, overlapBars 0, lookbackSec 0, mode mix, sampleRate 44100 }, B = the song length from lengths.json; three runs per song, each on a fresh Host; medians. One process per bench run, songs in file order.

snapshot.rule: median loadMs over the benchmark catalog > 100 ms or > 0.25 x median planMs

remeasure.change: planJob (src/lib/render/job-plan.ts) reuses the full-schedule selection when the chunk window is [0, c1): one query per full-song plan instead of two. Jobs byte-identical (every jobSha256 matches the run before).
remeasure.loadNote: another project's rustc builds were running throughout and could not be stopped from here

archiveNote: Historical budget summary for the original historical catalog catalog. The synthetic corpus supplies the current regression workload.
